visibleObservations.fact: The existing view visibly contains eight color bands, with the last band wrapping to a second line.
The Darkroom view visibly presents eight circles in one horizontal row.
Unedited circles are visibly dark inside with colored outlines; the selected circle has a white outer ring and a diagonal fill.
The histogram uses thin, separated vertical bars rather than wide blocks.
The Darkroom source image measures 586 by 618 pixels; deterministic measurement is recorded in the Darkroom evidence JSON.
The close histogram reference visibly shows a pale grey vertical overlay for the selected colour range over a continuous spectrum of coloured bars.

The live mixer maintains eight named bands and per-band hue, saturation, and luminance state.

applicableDesignRules.rule: Selected states must preserve their footprint so grids never reflow.

proposedInterpretations.statement: The isolated prototype will demonstrate the requested behavior without asserting a production design decision.

userDecisions.decision: Use only the Darkroom slider styling, thinner histogram bars, and circle design.
Keep the current eight color bands.
Unedited circles use a colored outline and transparent/dark center.
Edited circles use a diagonal original-color/new-color split.
The standalone HTML draft must be interactive for testing.
Keep all unrequested typography, spacing, and foundational styling on approved design tokens; add the specified Darkroom histogram and slider interactions to the pilot only.
Use square band selectors and square slider thumbs in this pilot variation; fix slider roll speed at 6.

Approve this design for rollout into chromasmith-22.html's shared .fx-slider/.fx-toggle/.fx-reset controls (all editor panels) and the Color Mixer's histogram/band selectors specifically — supersedes target-draft's 'drafts/color-mixer-pilot.html only' scope for the production implementation.
userDecisions.sourceRef: User request, 2026-09-13 (live chat approval, recorded after the fact)

geometrySpacing.statement: Use an eight-column, no-wrap grid for the bands; reduce the circle size responsively instead of wrapping.

colorsContrastRoles.statement: Use a dark center for an unedited band and a diagonal original/new-color fill only when that band's value is non-zero.

motionInteraction.statement: Reveal text-only Reset | All actions after an edit; preserve header space so this state change cannot shift neighboring controls.
The histogram's full colour-range zones select a band on hover or click, and show a pale grey selected-range overlay.
The experimental square thumbs rotate in proportion to adjustment value at a fixed roll speed of 6.

responsiveBehavior.statement: At all supported pilot widths, eight bands remain in one row; controls may shrink but do not wrap.

accessibility.statement: Use native checkbox, range, and number inputs with visible labels and focus styles in the pilot.

targets.statement: Create drafts/color-mixer-pilot.html only; do not update the live HTML application.
